verdict.rationale: doola documents a per-company compliance calendar listing the recurring obligations it tracks to keep the company in good standing, plus annual report filing support. This covers deadline tracking, a core part of the story, but no evidence shows proactive alerts or reminders sent ahead of deadlines. Missing for 10: documented advance alerts/notifications before deadlines, explicit franchise tax deadline coverage, confirmation that coverage spans every state where doola is registered agent, independent corroboration.
